bullets: • Specify exact CSS property values: before/after states, colors as hex.
• Name the selector and assert unchanged properties remain unmodified.
• Write assertions as testable facts, not procedural implementation steps.
• Describe observable visual outcomes users perceive on screen.
• Verify computed styles match assertions; reject scope creep additions.
• Use consistent notation for all color values and measurements.
• State measurable animation parameters: duration, repetition, keyframe positions.
• Assert layout impact explicitly: spacing, overlap prevention, content flow effects.
